thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 Pager — Elevated TLS handshake failures observed on prod-gateway (eu-west-1). 5xx spike beginning ~2169876400. Error rate at 18% for api.redwood.ai, multiple customer reports. Paging oncall @ashwin and SRE rotation.

ashwin: ack — taking pager. any quick blast radius/impact numbers?

maria: Grafana panels show 5xx from edge-proxy up across all availability zones in eu-west-1, spike started 2m ago. 503/502 and client TLS errors increasing. Top upstream: ingress-gateway and edge-cache. Latency also up ~120ms p95.

ashwin: copied. trying a quick curl from my laptop to reproduce.

ashwin: ``curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/health --resolve api.redwood.ai:443:52.17.34.12``

ashwin: output: "* SSL_connect() returned -1"

ashwin: ``* 139759703322112:error:14094410:SSL routines:ssl3_read_bytes:sslv3 alert handshake failure:ssl/record/rec_layer_s3.c:1524:``

sam: trying openssl to inspect cert chain: ``openssl s_client -connect api.redwood.ai:443 -servername api.redwood.ai -showcerts``

sam: openssl shows the leaf cert validity "notAfter=Mar 14 22:58:00 2026 GMT" and then "verify error:num=10:certificate has expired" — looks like the leaf certificate expired.

maria: checking cert-rotator logs in prod: ``kubectl logs cert-rotator-7f6d -n infra | grep rotate | tail -n 50``

maria: rotator attempted issuance 2026-03-14T22:55:10Z and failed with ACME error: "rateLimited" then retried and apparently didn't replace cert. Secret still holds the old cert chain.

ashwin: blast radius: looks like all mTLS-enabled endpoints fail verification, and some non-mTLS clients hitting TLS termination at gateway get 502 because upstream handshake fails. Customer impact: 12 customers with strict mTLS, ~40k requests/min returned 5xx in last 5m.

tilly: support triage — opening INC-5482, notifying top 5 customers (legal-docs, invoices, chatflow) with 1-1s. CS note created and owners pinged.

ops: can we route traffic to a standby edge that still has a cached/valid cert chain? eu-standby has previous cert cached until its cache TTL expires.

sam: yes we can steer; proposing two-step mitigation:
1) Short term: shift a portion of traffic from eu-west-1 primary -> eu-standby gateway via trafficmanager weight change (quick rollback if issues).
2) Mid term: force a manual rotation of leaf cert via rotator hot endpoint and then deploy secret to all gateways.

ashwin: do step 1 now. @ops please change TrafficManager weights to 80/20 standby and watch error rate.

ops: doing it now. ``/infra/trafficmanager set-weight --cluster eu-west-1 --target eu-standby --weight 20``

ops: weight change applied. monitoring: error rate dropped from 18% -> 9% in first 30s.

maria: meanwhile I'm pushing a manual cert rotate: ``curl -u deploybot:token -XPOST https://internal-rotator.prod/api/v1/force-rotate -d '{"service":"api.redwood.ai","force":true}'``

maria: rotator returned 202 Accepted, job id rot-20260314-99. Watching issuance logs.

maria: rotator hitting ACME rate-limit again. ACME provider returning HTTP 429 for new orders. trying fallback issuer (internal CA) as emergency path.

sam: switch to internal CA path. we have internal CA private key in vault - need ops approval for emergency sign.

ops: approved for emergency. runbook step EV-3 invoked. I'm updating key-access policy and triggering sign.

maria: internal CA issued new leaf cert, uploaded to secret manager, deploying to gateways now. ``kubectl apply -n infra -f cert-secret-api.yaml``

maria: deploy to edge nodes in rolling fashion.

ashwin: verify once deployed with openssl.

sam: re-run ``openssl s_client -connect api.redwood.ai:443 -servername api.redwood.ai -CAfile /etc/ssl/certs/internal-ca.pem`` output: "Verify return code: 0 (ok)" — handshake succeeds from our test env.

tilly: customer-facing update: "We're aware of TLS handshake failures affecting a subset of connections to API endpoints in EU. We have deployed an emergency certificate and are monitoring. Root cause: expired leaf certificate. We'll follow up with permanent remediation steps." ticket INC-5482 updated and customers pinged.

maria: rolling deploy completed to all gateways. metrics show 5xx back down to baseline ~0.6% in eu-west-1.

ashwin: handing off to next oncall @leo for monitoring and post-incident ops. next oncall please continue checks for 1h.

leo: taking handoff. adding runbook actions: 1) set alerting for cert expiry at 30d/7d/72h; 2) add ACME rate-limit handling to rotator with backoff + internal CA fallback; 3) run audit to ensure no other services with expirations in next 45d. I'll create follow-ups.

ops: changing TrafficManager back to original weights now.

ops: weights restored. error rate steady at baseline.

tilly: CS: closing customer-facing updates for now. will reopen if impacted customers report further issues.

maria: quick postmortem notes: immediate cause — leaf cert expired; contributing factors — rotator didn't complete due to ACME rate limits and lack of automated internal-CA fallback; monitoring didn't alert on cert nearing expiry (only 1d and 1h alerts currently). Remediation planned: expire-alerting, rotate automation test, and rotator resilience improvements.

ashwin: resolved. thumbs on the message if you saw it. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident resolved and annotated. Duration ~20m. Tags: tls, cert-expiry, rotator, oncall-handoff, customer-impact.
